global: This shoyu ramen features a rich, amber broth cradling noodles, topped with vibrant red peppers, green pickles, and a mound of white radish, all garnished with sesame seeds and green onions. The white bowl rests on a dark surface, illuminated by soft, even lighting that highlights the dish’s appetizing textures.

regions.background: Dark speckled table surface, smooth and uniform, with subtle grain texture visible under even lighting.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with glossy finish, smooth curved rim, and red Japanese characters on its edge.
regions.soup: The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is amber-brown, glossy, and clear, with visible noodles and toppings floating within.
